about: The compound as planned (D-017, corrected by the founder on 2026-10-27: D-022; bar and guest rooms swapped the same day). Metres; x runs east, y runs south, from the north-west corner of the drawing. Containers are ISO sizes; everything else is illustrative, not surveyed. Read by the 2D plan (src/components/home/compound-plan.tsx) and the 3D model (scripts/site/render/compound.html).

outdoor.about: From the 2026-10-25 footage and the founder's choices (D-022): a small camping lawn between the guest rooms and the fire pit, the cluster's east end flush with the fire pit's west edge (both drawings place it so, whatever the spread); a long timber table where today's unfinished platform stands in front of the middle studio; and stools round the fire pit.

neighbours.about: The master plan's neighbours of the compound (src/components/site/site.json), brought close so the homepage's 2D and 3D show them beside it at their true sizes (founder, 2026-10-29). Positions are in this file's frame AFTER the spread (x east, y south), so neither drawing spreads them again. The volleyball court stands on the lawn between the guest rooms and the parking, turned so its long side runs east-west (turn). The land lies west, past a break, as one horizontal band from the study room's back wall to the end of the first guest room (founder, 2026-10-29): the vegetable field turned a quarter (turn: plan.json's y runs west, its x runs toward the gates), the first half of each of its two blocks nearest the compound (beds, of ten) from public/designs/farming/data/plan.json, cut there (founder, 2026-10-29). The rest of the field, the nursery and the livestock lie beyond the cut: an arrow there links to /en/farming, which draws the whole farm. On the land the field starts some 26 m past the compound and the livestock lies beyond it, sited after the 200 m lake check. Each links to its page.

spread.about: The 2D and the 3D set the compound apart sideways for a wide screen, every building at its true size: x' = mid + (x - mid) * factor for each centre. The way in (the gates, the sign wall, the parking and the rock road) keeps the places it had at 1.5, where the founder wants the rock road, while the buildings take 1.8 (2026-10-27).
